program: One DHS People, Access and Culture Program with a federated One DSD People, Access and Culture expression

governingDecision.ownerDecision: Every supplied asset is qualitatively approved to enter the production corpus.
governingDecision.ingestionRule: Ingest and account for every source. Do not omit a source because editing remains.
governingDecision.releaseRule: Staff release is a separate decision requiring language alignment, factual currentness, accessibility, scope, placement, and rights review where applicable.
governingDecision.seedRule: Keep all 25 current seed items as a permanent collection with stable IDs and append-only revisions.
governingDecision.duplicateRule: Preserve every receipt, store one byte-identical payload, and never deduplicate by title alone.
governingDecision.visibilityRule: Source history and technical accounting remain internal. Staff see only warm, direct content plus owner, next review, applies to, and contact labels when useful.
governingDecision.protectedAssetRule: Do not change, replace, or overwrite the DHS logo.

identityCorrection.handling: Retain each original Drive title and ID. Record the owner's phrase as an alias only; do not rename source material without confirmation.
